title: Chapter 161 Break The Rules
content:
Chapter 161 Break The Rules

"Enjoy it."

Suddenly, a terrifying aura surged out of Shi Ren's body.

The powerful pressure of the mortal realm made the Divine Dynasty frightened and unable to move.

Except Lu Xue.

"Miss, aren't you going to showdown? Get out of here, if you don't, we'll be there!"

On the side, the man looked ugly and gritted his teeth.

Hearing this, Lu Xue let out a light sigh.

The next moment, a long sword emitting a mysterious light appeared in his hand.

At the same time, a picture appeared in Lu Xue's mind.

"Xiaoxue, you should take this sword to defend yourself. Remember, try not to use it unless it is absolutely necessary, it is very powerful."

"Huh? How big is it?"

"Probably, it's the limit you can reach in the world."

Lu Xue, who came back to her senses, looked at the Spirit-Devouring Army in the distance, and her eyes suddenly became extremely sharp.

"You guys forced me."

Seeing this scene, a fatal sense of threat surged in Shiren's heart.

Looking at Lu Xue, Shi Ren suddenly shouted: "Get back!"

However, it was too late to react at this time.

Lu Xue slashed out with a sword.

Buzz —

At this moment, the world changed.

An indescribable terrifying sword light slashed out from the sword, and the world seemed to be still, leaving only that dazzling sword light.

laugh!

The sky was torn apart, and the void was shattered into nothingness.

"No!!"

A desperate cry rang out.

The sound of swords that were like destruction resounded throughout the world.

The smoke of gunpowder dissipates.

In the end, the entire Spirit-Devouring Army was almost wiped out, leaving only a few Spirit-Devouring Powerful People who survived, but basically lost their combat capabilities.

The Horen, who was standing in front, was directly wiped out.

At this moment, the entire void became completely quiet, leaving only the sound of the void breaking down.

I don't know how long it took, but a murmur sounded.

"Me, am I dreaming?"

The man looked at Lu Xue's back and finally sat in the void.

If you have such a trump card, you will have to do this.

Wouldn't it be fine if I took it out earlier?

After a long time, I was always there for everyone.

In fact, Lu Xue didn't expect that she would use the trump card left by her father. She thought she could solve this crisis with her own strength, but who knew that the Spirit-Devouring Clan would be so strong.

After all, when it comes to returning to Huangcheng, it is also to use the trump card left by my father, so there is no difference.

Ao Qing also reacted and quickly shouted, "The little master is invincible!"

Seeing this, the others also yelled quickly.

"Your Highness the Princess is invincible!"

"Your Highness the Princess is invincible!"

At this time, the sword in Lu Xue's hand shattered.

"This, this is impossible."

"An hallucination must be an hallucination."

Shi Jin's face was desperate and his whole body was trembling violently.

Although the main target of that sword was not him, he was still affected. Just a aftermath caused him, the peak powerhouse in the Spirit-Devouring Clan, to be seriously injured.

The same is true for Shi Heng, who has been silent on the side.

That crazy woman is so strong, why is her daughter more perverted?

Why is this?

Unfortunately, they will never know the reason.

"No, everyone, come on, don't let them recover."

At this moment, the man in the half-step realm suddenly shouted.

Everyone was stunned and immediately noticed that the flesh and blood of the Spirit-Devouring Army were secretly devouring the flesh and blood of the Spirit-Devouring Army in the void.

Seeing this scene, everyone rushed towards the two of them.

Although they are powerful people in the mortal realm and their strength is far above them, they are now seriously injured. I guess they can't even exert 10% of their usual strength, so they are no longer afraid.

And Shi Jin and the others looked extremely ugly.

"run!"

The next moment, the two of them used their last trace of strength to break through the void and disappeared directly from the spot.

After all, he is a peak strong man at the mortal realm. Although he is seriously injured, if he wants to escape, he is not something that anyone present can stop him.

Seeing the two of them running away under the noses of everyone, everyone looked gloomy.

"My master, what should I do now?"

At this time, Ao Qing came to Lu Xue.

"Cleaning the battlefield."

Upon hearing this, everyone did not hesitate and acted quickly.

There are still many people from the Spirit-Devouring Clan who are not dead in the void.

Lu Xue looked at the depths of the void with a calm expression.

The crisis here has been resolved, so it should be much easier for my mother to go.

She also let the two of them go on purpose.

She knew that after these two people escaped, they would definitely go to another battlefield, and then her mother would know that there was nothing wrong here.

Sure enough, after Shi Jin and the others broke through the void, their first reaction was to gallop towards the unknown boundary.

"Earth, what should I do now?"

Shi Heng looked ugly and asked at Shi Jin on the side.

Hearing this, Ember was silent.

What can I do? I can only wait for the next better opportunity to take over this star field.

Until now, Shi Jin was still thinking about devouring this star field in his mind.

He didn't know that when his Spirit-Devouring Clan had this idea, extermination was their only result.

"Go to find the patriarch first."

Immediately, the two continued to move towards the unknown border.

.........

"Fellow Daoist, if you move forward, you will be in the chaotic void. Stop."

A sound rang out from around.

Lu Daosheng stopped and turned to look aside.

I saw a phantom slowly emerge and gradually condensed.

It was a gray-haired old man.

"You've been staying here?"

Lu Daosheng asked.

Hearing this, the old man immediately laughed.

"I am not here. With my strength, I can ascend to the sky long ago. Why do you think I will stay in this world?"

It seemed that Lu Daosheng was extraordinary, and the old man started chatting with Lu Daosheng.

When Lu Daosheng heard the old man's words, he smiled.

"You want to forcefully break through this world without being restricted by rules."

As soon as these words came out, the old man's smile suddenly frozen.

Looking at Lu Daosheng again, the old man's expression gradually became solemn.

Can't see through at all.

"Who are you?"

The old man finally began to face up to the young Lu Daosheng in front of him.

I thought the other party just happened to come here, but now it seems that it is not the case.

"Lu Daosheng."

Lu Daosheng has never concealed his name.

"Lu Daosheng? I don't recognize you. You should not be from this world."

The old man thought for a long time, but there was no information about Lu Daosheng in his mind.

Lu Daosheng nodded.

"Forcibly breaking through, there will be great risks. Once you fail, you will die. Are you sure you will take such a risk?"

Lu Daosheng's words silenced the old man.

After a long time, the old man shook his head slightly.

"I have long known what level of practice that follows the rules, but in that case, it will end."

"Cultivation is about going against the will of heaven. Since you have chosen to practice, you will naturally take the strongest path."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's expression lit up.

The old man in front of him is really not simple.

Unexpectedly, there will be such a person in this world.

"You used to be very famous in this world."

Hearing this, the old man smiled, "That's all the past."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng also smiled.

"Your idea is very good, but thinking alone is useless. Do you know why you are still in this world for so many years?"

"Because you just think, but don't take action. Facing the rules of heaven and earth, facing this chaotic void, you are afraid, and if you have fear in your heart, how can you talk about breaking the rules?"

Boom!

Lu Daosheng's words exploded in the old man's mind like thunder.

Seeing the old man stunned, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly, then turned around and punched him.

There was a loud bang.

The world barrier in front of him was directly blown open a huge gap, revealing the terrifying and wanton void turbulence inside.

Without hesitation, Lu Daosheng stepped in and entered the chaotic void that made countless strong men desperate.

After Lu Daosheng entered, the gap healed quickly.

When I was in place, I don’t know how long it took, the old man slowly came back to his senses.

Lu Daosheng left.

But Lu Daosheng's words woke him up.

"It turns out that over the years, it's not the rules that bind me, but myself."

The old man murmured to himself.

The next moment, the old man's aura suddenly began to surge wildly!
